About — v5.5.9

01 — Detox Control Panel

Three modes.
One glance.

A minimalist awareness hub at the top of your home — live clock, battery, weather, and a triple-mode widget that surfaces exactly the right information at the right moment.

  • Large Clock & Date: Centred, always visible, never cluttered. Supports 12h and 24h formats.
  • Toggles Mode: One-tap WiFi, Bluetooth, Silent, Torch, Airplane, Dark Mode. Long-press to go straight to system settings.
  • Music Mode: Full media controls — play/pause, skip, track name, artist, and a live progress bar.
  • Focus Mode: Real-time unlock count, total notifications, and your Focus Score all in one widget.
  • Smart Weather: Live temperature and conditions from Open-Meteo — no account, zero tracking.
TogglesNow Playing Focus StatsOpen-Meteo

02 — Ultra-Focus Mode PRO

Deep work.
No compromise.

Start a timed session and watch your phone transform into a pure productivity instrument. No icons. No colour. No temptation. Just the apps you need and a countdown.

  • Timed Sessions: 15m, 30m, 1h, or 2h — pick your window and commit.
  • Essentials Only: Phone, Camera, Maps, WhatsApp, Messaging, Music, Notes — nothing else.
  • Text-Only UI: All icons and tiles removed. Lowercase extra-light typography eliminates every visual trigger.
  • Alphabetical: Essentials sorted A–Z for instant, predictable access under pressure.
  • Auto Revert: Your normal layout is restored the moment the timer expires — automatically.
15m · 30m · 1h · 2h 7 Core AppsAuto Revert

03 — Aesthetic & Visual Engine

Every theme.
Your identity.

From liquid glass animations to Material You dynamic colour — Dotz's visual engine makes your launcher feel genuinely personal without ever feeling busy.

  • Liquid Glass: GPU-optimised animated gradients with frosted glassmorphism on all tiles, panels, and dialogs.
  • 5 Presets: Dotz Dark, Nordic Blue, Deep Forest Green, Sunset Amber, Dotz Light.
  • Material You: Full Android 12+ dynamic colour palette support.
  • Circadian PRO: Tones shift automatically — cool morning blues to warm evening ambers.
  • Transparent PRO: Wallpaper shows through with precision tile transparency slider.
  • Grayscale Schedule: Auto-enable monochrome after 10 PM to wind down.
Liquid Glass5 Presets Material YouCircadian PRO

04 — Dynamic Tile System

Up to 18 tiles.
Zero clutter.

An expandable, rearrangeable grid designed to surface only what matters — with smart badges that inform without overwhelming and a daily budget that protects your attention.

  • Expandable Grid: Up to 18 tiles across three smooth horizontal pages.
  • Grid & List: Switch between a high-impact 2×3 Grid or a focused List layout.
  • Rearrangeable: Long-press to lift and swap tiles directly on screen — no settings required.
  • Smart Badges: Subtle dots or precise counts for calls and messages only.
  • Budgeted Drawer: Bottom-sheet drawer capped at 5 emergency opens per day.
Up to 18 TilesGrid · List 5 Drawer Opens/Day

05 — Digital Balance & Mindfulness

Your phone works
for you.

Dotz actively intervenes when habits drift — with proactive dialogs, live usage timers, and daily friction that makes you pause before you scroll.

  • Mindful Check-in: A prompt appears on the 3rd open of any distracting app — showing usage time before proceeding.
  • Focus Score: A 0–100 metric deducting points for excessive unlocks and screen time. Live in the header.
  • Real-time Usage: Per-app foreground time displayed directly on tiles and in the app drawer.
  • Icon Dimming: Icons fade to 20% after 30 minutes of use today — a visual nudge to put it down.
  • Midnight Reset: All daily budgets and counters reset automatically at 12:00 AM.
Focus Score20% Icon Fade 5 Drawer OpensMidnight Reset

06 — Timeline Timeline PRO

Your day,
in sequence.

Swipe right for Timeline — a PRO-exclusive chronological feed of today's notifications, live music, and most-used apps. Reply without opening a single app.

  • Chronological Feed: Notifications, app launches, and media activity in one vertical timeline.
  • Quick Reply: Reply to WhatsApp, Telegram, and SMS directly from the feed.
  • Media Controller: Playback controls with live track and artist — integrated into the timeline.
  • Multiple Profiles: Separate Work, Home, and Focus setups with independent layouts and themes.
  • Vertical Scrolling: Switch pages to vertical for comfortable one-handed use.
PRO ExclusiveQuick Reply ProfilesJSON Backup

07 — Performance & Privacy

Nothing leaves
your device.

100% local. 100% Kotlin. Android 15 optimised. Dotz runs silently and efficiently — no trackers, no cloud sync, no compromise on speed or privacy.

  • High Refresh Rate: Auto-detects 90Hz / 120Hz / 144Hz for buttery-smooth Compose animations.
  • Privacy First: Zero personal data ever leaves your device. Non-personalised ads (NPA) only.
  • Pure Compose: No legacy Views, no bloat — frame-perfect transitions with minimal battery draw.
  • Android 15 Ready: Predictive back gesture, edge-to-edge navigation, latest system standards.
  • Open Source: Every line on GitHub — read it, fork it, audit it.
90–144HzZero Tracking Android 15Open Source

The Story

I built the launcher
I couldn't find.

In 2022, I was averaging 7+ hours of screen time a day. Not because I wanted to — but because every app on my phone was engineered to keep me there. I tried screen time limits. I tried grayscale. I tried deleting Instagram fourteen times.

Nothing worked because the problem wasn't the apps. It was the launcher — that first screen you see every time you unlock your phone. Every icon a temptation. Every notification badge a hook.

So I built Dotz. A launcher that treats your attention as the most valuable thing you own — not something to be monetised. It's minimal because distraction is loud. It's intentional because your phone should work for you, not against you.

Dotz is free to use. The source is public. And every feature exists because I needed it myself.

Amal S. Nair

FAQ

Common questions.

Yes, completely free. You can watch a single rewarded ad to unlock all PRO features for 24 hours — or just use the free tier indefinitely. There are no subscriptions, no paywalls, and no hidden costs. The app is also fully open source on GitHub.
The free tier includes the full home screen experience — all tile layouts, mindfulness features, Focus Score, header modes, and settings. PRO unlocks Timeline Timeline, Circadian and Transparent themes, and future PRO-exclusive features. PRO access is granted by watching a single rewarded ad, valid for 24 hours.
Zero. All usage statistics, notification content, app lists, and settings are stored locally on your device. Nothing is ever transmitted to any server. Ad delivery (for the rewarded PRO unlock) uses non-personalised ads (NPA) only — no tracking, no profiling. You can verify this by reading the source code on GitHub.
Notification Access is required for two things: displaying notification dots and counts on home screen tiles, and populating the Timeline Timeline. All notification content is processed locally and never leaves your device. You can grant or revoke this permission at any time from Android Settings → Apps → Notification Access.
Yes. Go to Settings → Export Settings to save your entire configuration — tile assignments, profiles, appearance settings — to a JSON file. You can import this on any Android device running Dotz. This makes switching phones or restoring after a reset effortless.
Dotz supports Android 7.0 (API 24) and above, targeting Android 15 (API 35). It's optimised for predictive back gesture, edge-to-edge navigation, and high refresh rate displays (90Hz, 120Hz, 144Hz) on supported devices. Pure Jetpack Compose means no legacy view rendering.
Yes — the full source is available at github.com/amalsnair535/DotzLauncherPRO. Bug reports, feature requests, and pull requests are welcome. Please open an issue before submitting a large PR so we can discuss the approach. The project is built entirely in Kotlin with Jetpack Compose.
Your Focus Score starts at 100 each day and decreases based on two factors: how many times you unlock your device, and your total screen time. The exact formula is designed to reflect intentional vs. reflexive phone use. You can see your current score in the header by switching to Focus mode. Everything resets at midnight.

Privacy
guaranteed.

Dotz Launcher collects zero personal data. Every usage statistic, notification, and setting lives exclusively on your device.

  • Zero transmission: No data ever leaves your device.
  • No accounts: No sign-up, no login, no profile.
  • No analytics SDK: No Firebase Analytics, no Crashlytics tracking.
  • NPA ads only: Rewarded ads use non-personalised delivery — no profiling.
  • Local storage only: All preferences stored in Android DataStore on-device.
  • Auditable: Every privacy claim is verifiable in the public source code.

Open source.
Always.

Every line of Dotz is public on GitHub. Read it, fork it, audit it, or contribute. The launcher you use is exactly the code you can inspect.

  • 100% Kotlin: Modern, readable, idiomatic Android code.
  • Pure Compose: No XML layouts, no legacy Views.
  • No obfuscation: Source maps and readable names throughout.
  • GitHub Issues: Bug reports and feature requests tracked publicly.
  • PRs welcome: Contributions reviewed and merged.
  • MIT spirit: Fork it, learn from it, build on it.
